programme.title: Computer Science BSc
programme.how_found: Official search result -> courses.leeds.ac.uk course page (entry requirements, English, fees on the page); deadline from the university-wide application timetable; scholarships from the undergraduate international scholarships page.
programme.notes: Typical A-level offer AAA with Mathematics.

english.quote: IELTS 6.0 overall, with no less than 5.5 in each section.
english.notes: Programme page. Other tests via the 'English language equivalent qualifications' page (not read).

value.description: No GPA threshold; qualification grades: A-level AAA incl. Mathematics; IB 18 points at Higher level incl. 5 in HL Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or 6 in HL Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation; other countries via 'international equivalent qualifications'.

gpa.quote: 18 points at Higher level to include 5 in HL Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches or 6 in HL Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation.

deadline.quote: 13 January 2027 – UCAS equal consideration application deadline for all other courses. Applications may be accepted after this deadline if the course still has places available.
deadline.notes: University-wide timetable (scoped to the university, per the owner ruling for UK universities). International students apply through UCAS like UK students (course page: 'International students apply through UCAS'). It is an equal-consideration date, not a hard close.

tuition.notes: Programme page. The year is inferred from the same fee block ('Tuition fees for UK undergraduate students starting in 2027/28 are £10,050.') and the page's 2027 admissions policy; the international line itself does not name the year. 'The international fee applies for each year of full-time study and will remain the same for the duration of your course.'

value.name: International Undergraduate Regional Scholarships (University of Leeds)

scholarship_exists.quote: An automatic £5,000 fee reduction scholarship is available for international students from an eligible country/region.
scholarship_exists.notes: Published for September 2026 entrants (academic year 2026/27); the 2027 round is not yet published. First-year fee reduction; passport holders of a listed country/region (Canada, Egypt, European Union, Hong Kong, India, Indonesia, Jordan, Kenya, Nigeria, Norway, Singapore, Switzerland, Turkey, USA); self-funded or partially funded. The page also announces 'up to £4.7 million worth of scholarships available for international students commencing their studies in September 2026'.

scholarship_international.quote: We have up to £4.7 million worth of scholarships available for international students commencing their studies in September 2026.
scholarship_international.notes: Open to internationals for the 2026 intake; eligibility for the Regional Scholarship depends on passport country. 2027 not yet published.
